study.title: Adult Education Survey 2022 (AES): Model questions

authors.name: Eurostat
authors.affiliation: European Commission, Eurostat, Unit F-3: Labour market and lifelong learning

study.citation: Eurostat. (2023). 2022 AES manual: Methodological guidelines for the adult education survey (Version 1.3, 30 March 2023). European Commission, Eurostat, Unit F-3. https://circabc.europa.eu/w/browse/a81f03f5-b8e6-4b84-a93d-ef847ef85db0
study.sourceLabel: 2022 AES MANUAL V1.3, Section 3 "Explanatory notes" (Eurostat, CIRCABC)
study.abstract: Model questions proposed by Eurostat for the 2022 wave of the EU Adult Education Survey, which national statistical institutes adapt into their own questionnaires. They ask adults about their household and background, labour status and job, access to guidance, participation in formal and non-formal education and training in the last 12 months (with details on the most recent formal activity and a randomly selected non-formal activity), obstacles to participation, informal learning, languages, health and household income. The wording follows the 2022 AES manual, version 1.3 (2023); Eurostat’s earlier model questionnaire for the 2022 AES (2021) is at https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/cache/metadata/Annexes/trng_aes_12m_sims_hr_an_3.pdf.

survey.name: restime
survey.label:
For native-born persons the following questions are recommended:
Did you ever live [have your usual residence] abroad for a period of at least 1 year? y/n
If yes: Considering the date you last arrived in this country (established your usual residence in this country) – for how many years have you lived in this country since then? [please consider whole/completed years only]
For foreign-born persons the following question is recommended:
Considering the date you last arrived in this country (established your usual residence in this country) – for how many years have you lived in this country since then? [please consider whole/completed years only]
survey.hint: Different questions need to be asked depending on whether a person was born in the country or not.

survey.label: Number of years in this country (since last establishing the place of usual residence in this country)

survey.name: marstadefacto

survey.name: dropeduc_g
survey.label: Educational attainment - details, including education interrupted or abandoned

survey.name: dropeduc
survey.label: Are there any formal education programmes that you started, but then stopped without completing?
survey.hint: Please consider all formal education programmes that you ever started but then did not successfully complete. Please also include changes of field. If you are currently participating in a formal programme, this programme should not be taken into account. However, if you are currently taking a gap year, please include it.

survey.name: dropeduclevel
survey.label: What was the level of this formal education programme?
survey.hint:
In case of several programmes not completed, please report the programme with the highest level; in case of several programmes not completed at the same level, please report the orientation of the most recent one.
Please use the national ISCED mapping to identify and classify the programme.

survey.label: Is this because you did not need additional education or training?
survey.hint: NONEED_A: for persons who participated in education and training and did not want to participate more (WANT_A = no / WANT = 1)

survey.name: want_b
survey.label: You have previously indicated that you did not participate in any formal or non-formal education and training activities. Would you have liked to participate in such education and training activities in the past 12 months?
survey.hint: WANT_B: for persons who did not participate in any formal or non-formal education and training (FEDNUM = 0 and NFENUM = 0)

survey.name: noneed_b
survey.label: Is this because you did not need education or training?
survey.hint: NONEED_B: for persons who did not participate in education and training and did not want to participate (WANT_B = no / WANT = 3)

survey.label:
From the following list, what were the reasons for you not to participate in education and training? (mark all that apply)

survey.name: diffmain

survey.name: informal
survey.label: Informal learning

survey.name: inf_intro
survey.label:
Apart from the learning activities mentioned earlier, you can also deliberately acquire or improve knowledge and skills in a planned manner by self-learning or teaching yourself, whether at work or during your free time, alone or with others. Below is a list of various forms how this can be done.
Or
Apart from the learning activities mentioned earlier, you can also acquire or improve knowledge and skills on your own, outside of institutionalised education and training activities, either at work or during your free time. Yet, this learning must be planned beforehand and you must have goals for yourself regarding own efforts and outcomes. In being intentional and planned, such learning is distinguished from incidental or random learning, i.e. knowledge and skills that we acquire every day, without thinking much about it.
survey.hint: Suggested introduction to the model question:

survey.name: inf
survey.label: During the past 12 months, have you deliberately tried to learn anything on a particular topic or area, or are you currently doing it, through one of the forms mentioned below? (mark all that apply)

survey.name: infpurp
survey.label: Were any of these informal learning activities mainly job-related?
